title: Western Harbour Tunnel Project-Specific Application Accuracy Contract Instantiation Closeout

project.name: Western Harbour Tunnel and Warringah Freeway Upgrade
project.qoi: groundwater head/drawdown prediction at decision-relevant receptors and monitoring locations

scientific_and_policy_finding.interpretation: SSI-8863 provides strong project-specific groundwater modelling, uncertainty, monitoring, update and peer-review governance. That is not the same as an externally governed numerical acceptance limit on groundwater-head/drawdown prediction error. No admissible numerical H_app was identified, and no independently governed allocation of application accuracy to temporal/coupling numerical error was identified. Therefore the canonical runtime contract cannot be positively instantiated for this project without inventing policy.

rejected_shortcuts: 1 L/s/km tunnel inflow criterion as H_app
drawdown, settlement or receptor impact thresholds as H_app
calibration RMSE or residuals as prospective H_app
model ensemble spread, uncertainty percentile or confidence class as H_app without external acceptance semantics
monitoring trigger as H_app without a governed prediction-error rule
groundwater model timestep schedule as A_temporal
F-GC07 empirical coupling error as A_temporal
arbitrary percentage allocation to coupling temporal error

architecture_invariants.13: PASS mass conservation remains absolute and untouched
architecture_invariants.15: PASS no additional production SWAP runs or coupling cost imposed
architecture_invariants.23: PASS application/numerical policy remains separate from physics

architecture_invariants.29: PASS no hidden project, file-format, calendar or MODFLOW assumptions introduced into kernel code

hard_nonclaims: no claim that Western Harbour Tunnel groundwater modelling is scientifically inadequate
no claim that its uncertainty analysis is invalid
no numeric WHT coupling head-error budget
reopen_condition: A positive project-specific instantiation requires new versioned evidence that explicitly governs a numerical groundwater-head/drawdown prediction-accuracy requirement and an independently governed temporal/coupling allocation or direct temporal head-error budget. Model outputs or calibration statistics alone are insufficient.
recommended_next_purpose: Define a reusable evidence-ingestion and governance template so future real projects can supply H_app and A_temporal without changing SWAP kernel or inventing project policy inside scientific workunits. This next unit must not choose numbers itself.
